crossRefs.note: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.
For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in…
His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.

translations.web: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’
translations.bsb: Would I lie about my case? My wound is incurable, though I am without transgression.’
translations.kjv: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
translations.asv: Notwithstanding my right I am accounted a liar; My wound is incurable, though I am without transgression.
